activity.notes: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk chaired the Grand National Assembly from 24 April 1920 to 29 October 1923, as recorded in the Assembly's official list of speakers. The Ministry of Culture and Tourism describes the chairmanship in this period as equivalent to combined state and government leadership. This Activity represents national governing authority in the Ankara-based Government of the Grand National Assembly of Turkey, whose name is independently attested in the 1921 Moscow treaty and the 1923 Lausanne instruments published by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. It is not an ordinary legislative speakership under the later republic. His re-election on 13 August 1923 did not interrupt the chairmanship; one continuous Activity is retained. The existing Turkey presidential Activity begins on 29 October 1923 and remains unchanged. No presidency before proclamation of the republic is asserted. This interval covers the Assembly chairmanship only and does not assert a separate executive-council premiership for its entire duration.
